armor.name: Spiked armor
armor.description: Any entity either grappling or being grappled by the wearer of this armor will take 1 Damage at the start of their turn.

armor.name: Arnomr
armor.description: Living armor that feeds on the wearer when invigorated. Whenever the wearer rolls for Mana Saturation Arnomr consumes part of the wearer, dealing 1 unreducible Damage and gaining 1 Block, up to a maximum of 4. At the end of each Shift, Arnomr loses 1 Block.

armor.name: Magnet armor
armor.description: -1 speed, +1 Block. Covered in magnets that nullify the effects of external mana saturation. Wearer has Boon(2) on rolls against Mana Saturation, but Bane(2) when rolling for spellcasting.
